title: Sensitive and eco-friendly extraction of antifungal drugs from artificial urine and saliva samples using MSPE coupled with HPLC-DAD
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18697-18708
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09942K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amina Ben Ayed, Songül Ulusoy, Halil İbrahim Ulusoy, Ümmügülsüm Polat, Hamadi Khemakhem
Fe3O4@SiO2–TMA magnetic adsorbent enabled efficient MSPE-HPLC-DAD determination of bifonazole and itraconazole in biological samples. The method showed high sensitivity, accuracy (94.7–107.5%), and good greenness, offering a reliable approach for samples.
